_doc: The rival smith (GDD 4.5.5) [balance]. H3 uses: sell_min_demand (sells an item while its demand is >= this; the difficulty's rival_sell_min_demand replaces it), gold_reserve (keeps this much when buying inputs), work_mode, work_phases (produces only then), decide_on (when it thinks: at dawn and at every phase change), buy_days (inputs for this many days of work), accepts_contracts. weights/aggression/risk_aversion/rivalry_threshold/preferred_professions are for the family AI of H6 (GDD 4.21).
